about: Talents: roll d100 for the category, then d10 within it; where several Talents share a d10 result the player picks one. double marks a Talent that takes two Talent slots (an asterisk in the table; the Players' Book's own example also counts Law Enforcement as two). table_name is the name the category table uses where Appendix B names the Talent differently.

talents.name: Guns
talents.summary: +1CS to hit with guns of every kind.

talents.name: Thrown Weapons
talents.summary: +1CS with weapons made to be thrown.

talents.name: Bows
talents.summary: +1CS with bows and crossbows, where the untrained take -1CS.

talents.name: Blunt Weapons
talents.summary: +1CS to hit with weapons that strike on Blunt Attacks.

talents.name: Sharp Weapons
talents.summary: +1CS to hit with bladed weapons.

talents.name: Oriental Weapons
talents.summary: +1CS with shuriken, sais, katana and the like.

talents.name: Marksman
talents.summary: +1CS with line-of-sight ranged weapons, and no range penalty.

talents.name: Weapons Master
talents.summary: +1CS with any weapon that hits on Fighting.

talents.name: Weapons Specialist
talents.summary: +2CS and +1 initiative with one chosen weapon.

talents.name: Martial Arts A
talents.summary: Can Stun or Slam regardless of Strength or Endurance.

talents.name: Martial Arts B
talents.summary: +1CS Fighting in unarmed combat.

talents.name: Martial Arts C
talents.summary: +1CS for grappling and escaping, and for dodging.

talents.name: Martial Arts D
talents.summary: After two rounds of study, ignores Body Armor for Stun and Slam.

talents.name: Martial Arts E
talents.summary: +1 to initiative in unarmed combat.

talents.name: Wrestling
talents.summary: +2CS to hit when grappling.

talents.name: Thrown Objects
talents.summary: +1CS on all throwing and on catching.

talents.name: Tumbling
talents.summary: An Agility FEAT to land safely from a fall.

talents.name: Acrobatics
talents.summary: +1CS when dodging, evading and escaping.

talents.name: Medicine
talents.summary: Healing, reviving the dying, +1CS on medical Reason FEATs.

talents.name: Law
talents.summary: +1CS on FEATs involving the law.

talents.name: Law Enforcement
talents.summary: Includes Guns and Law; may carry a gun and arrest.

talents.name: Pilot
talents.summary: +1CS on FEATs flying or designing aircraft.

talents.name: Military
talents.summary: +1CS in military matters and a military Contact.

talents.name: Business/Finance
talents.summary: Resources at least Good, +1CS with money, a Contact.

talents.name: Journalism
talents.summary: Two extra media Contacts.

talents.name: Engineering
talents.summary: +1CS on FEATs to build things.

talents.name: Criminology
talents.summary: +1CS on Reason and Intuition FEATs about crime, and a Contact.

talents.name: Psychiatry
talents.summary: +1CS on FEATs involving the mind and mental Powers.

talents.name: Detective/Espionage
talents.summary: +1CS to find clues, and a Contact.

talents.name: Chemistry
talents.summary: +1CS on Reason FEATs in chemistry.

talents.name: Biology
talents.summary: +1CS on Reason FEATs in biology.

talents.name: Geology
talents.summary: +1CS on Reason FEATs about the Earth.

talents.name: Genetics
talents.summary: +1CS on Reason FEATs about genes and mutants.

talents.name: Archaeology
talents.summary: +1CS on Reason FEATs about the past.

talents.name: Physics
talents.summary: +1CS on Reason FEATs in physics and astrophysics.

talents.name: Computers
talents.summary: +1CS on Reason FEATs about computers and AIs.

talents.name: Electronics
talents.summary: +1CS on Reason FEATs about electronics.

talents.name: Trance
talents.summary: A death-like trance; regains one Endurance rank a day.

talents.name: Mesmerism and Hypnosis
talents.summary: Mind Control at the hero's Reason rank, easily broken.

talents.name: Sleight of Hand
talents.summary: Palms small items at Agility +1CS.

talents.name: Resist Domination
talents.summary: Resists mental attacks as Psyche +1CS.

talents.name: Mystic Background
talents.summary: May have magical Powers, with the Judge's approval.

talents.name: Occult Lore
talents.summary: +1CS on Reason FEATs about magical things.

talents.name: Artist
talents.summary: Earns Karma from finished works of art.

talents.name: Languages
talents.summary: One extra language, and more at half cost.

talents.name: First Aid
talents.summary: Stops a dying hero's Endurance loss and restores a rank.

talents.name: Repair/Tinkering
talents.summary: +1CS on Reason FEATs to repair or modify things.

talents.name: Trivia
talents.summary: +1CS on Reason FEATs in one narrow subject.

talents.name: Performer
talents.summary: Earns Karma from a week of performing.

talents.name: Animal Training
talents.summary: Teaches animals tricks; +1CS to animal Powers.

talents.name: Heir to Fortune
talents.summary: Resources at least Remarkable; only at creation.

talents.name: Student
talents.summary: No other starting Talents, but later ones cost less; only at creation.

talents.name: Leadership
talents.summary: +50 Karma to a Karma Pool the hero leads.
